title: Set up the three locations
alt: Actual Settings screen with demo paths. Callout 1 is Source Root for the camera card, 2 is Local Staging Directory, and 3 is Archive or NAS Directory.
caption: 1 Camera/card source. 2 Your working staging library. 3 Archive destination. These are demo paths; choose the folders on your own computer.

title: Preview a B&W finish before queuing
alt: Actual B&W Conversion controls with illustrative demo media. Callout 1 identifies S-curve strength and 2 identifies the separate result preview beside the original.
caption: 1 Adjust the tonal curve and other controls. 2 Compare the sample result with its original. The illustration demonstrates the controls, not a calibrated processing result; use 100% to judge your own photograph.

title: Choose the exact versions to share
alt: Actual Lightbox review controls with illustrative demo media. Callouts 1, 2 and 3 identify the independent Google Photos checkboxes for Original, B&W and Enhanced.
caption: Use the Folder view bar to find the next photograph, then choose each exact version separately: 1 Original, 2 B&W, 3 Enhanced. These local selections do not start an upload. The screenshot uses an illustrative demo library.

title: Find and select a source frame
alt: Actual Video snapshots workspace with illustrative demo media. Callout 1 identifies the exact video frame position slider and 2 the Frame selected confirmation.
caption: 1 Move through the original video. 2 Select the moment into the Photo Tray. Demo artwork is used here; the preview is for browsing, while export reads the original full-resolution frame.

title: Export from the Photo Tray
alt: Actual Photo Tray showing the selected demo photograph, destination-folder control and full-resolution export action.
caption: Choose the destination in the Photo Tray, confirm the shooting time, then use Export full-resolution photos. A missing folder or unconfirmed time keeps export disabled and explains why.

title: Your everyday photo workflow
alt: Import and verify originals; create independent Enhanced and B&W versions; review, crop and choose exact versions in Lightbox; upload selected photos and verify archive copies.
caption: Follow one event from camera card to sharing and archive. Keep the staging library as your working collection.

title: Understand the photo family
alt: An unchanged camera JPEG independently supplies B&W, Enhanced and a new crop family. The cropped JPEG has its own optional generated versions.
caption: Generated versions are separate files. A crop preserves the camera original and creates a new family for your cropped view.

title: An optional RAW path
alt: Use Camera JPEG by default, explicitly develop a RAW alternative, choose which view to inspect, then select exact physical versions for sharing or archive.
caption: Use your camera JPEG for everyday review. Develop RAW when you want to revisit exposure, colour or the creative finish.

title: The video-making sequence
alt: Build the clip sequence; prepare stabilised picture and review it; configure titles, chapters and scorecards; finish camera sound and music and export the updated final.
caption: Picture preparation and final assembly have different jobs. Valid cached pictures can survive later graphics or soundtrack edits.

title: From a video moment to a photograph
alt: Open original video, confirm its shooting start, choose an exact frame, select it into the Photo Tray, then export a photograph from the original at full available resolution. Timestamp is shooting start plus frame time.
caption: The browser-sized preview helps you choose a moment. The Photo Tray export creates the full-resolution photograph.

title: What verified archive transfer means
alt: Review chosen files, copy with bounded adaptive workers, independently read destination bytes and compare checksums, then record the verified result in the MD5 register and run manifest.
caption: Copy speed matters, but verification is part of completion. A selected archive is only a backup of what you included.
